title: Hero Match
description:
Hero Match: Blast, Build & Save the World!
Welcome to Hero Match! Join our fearless superhero, solve match 3 puzzles, take down the villain, and restore iconic locations across the globe!

title: Papa's Wingeria
description: Papa’s Wingeria is a casual restaurant game where you cook delicious wings for customers. Learn to serve the perfect plate of wings and purchase upgrades to improve the customer experience.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Digital Circus Run
description: In Digital Circus Run, the mysterious Caine creates casual parkour and endless running courses that you must traverse. In this virtual circus, you must assist the captives in escaping by navigating them through increasingly difficult stages. As you lead Pomni around the virtual circus, your abilities will be challenged.

title: Guinea Piggy Matching
description:
Guinea Piggy Match uses well known and easy to learn game mechanics. Your target is to take apart a pattern made of tiles. 
For each completed level, you are given a golden puzzle piece. For these, you can uncover images of cute guinea piggies.

title: Hexa Sort 3D
description: Hexa Sort 3D mixes puzzle challenges, strategic matching and a satisfying merging experience.Involving clever puzzle-solving and logical manoeuvres, this game is ideal for those seeking a mental workout. As the levels progress, players will find the game both addictive and calming, striking the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Put your skills to the test with tasks such as sorting, stacking and merging hexagonal tiles.

title: Skibronx Runner
description: Make your way through the streets in this endless runner game while you encounter various challenges. In the level mode its your goal to reach the grocery store without losing. In the endless mode your goal is to reach as far as possible without losing.

title: Student and Teacher
description:
The school is not ready for you!
Broken laptops, chairs in splinters, the dining room is looted!
Revenge is a dish served in the form of chaos!
Forget about the silent protest – only crushing anarchy!
Make your classmates regret it!
The teacher is in a panic!
The head teacher is furious!
The main thing is not to get caught and avenge the setup!

title: NinjaRoof
description: NinjaRoof is a fast-paced and addictive arcade game where players control a nimble character jumping from rooftop to rooftop while avoiding deadly obstacles and aiming for the highest score. Test your timing, precision, and reflexes in this endless jumping adventure built with smooth physics and clean visuals.

title: Garden Guardians
description:
A fun and strategic tower defense game that’s easy to pick up!
Tap directional arrows to launch seeds into flowerpots—each seed blossoms into a powerful flower ready to blast incoming zombies. Plan your moves, hold the line, and protect your garden from the undead horde!

title: Noob fun fishing
description: Catch all the fish with Noob - from small to very large, normal and predatory. Upgrade your fishing rod, buy and upgrade your boat, use modifiers for your fishing rod. Open the catalog of all the fish in the game.

title: Bitball
description:
A unique tile ball puzzle game from coin base bitcoin games loved by millions of players around the world. 
Make a lot of coins and become a rich. ?
 - Start with 10 and start making millions. ?
 - Coun you rech the topmillioners.❓
 - Play with friend together.?
 - Guess the ball where it will go.?

title: Bike Stunt Racing Legend
description: Bike Stunt Racing Legend is not merely a motorcycle racing but also a balanced stunt simulation game. Under a 3D game engine, you are required to ride the motorbike to the finish line in the first place. As long as you can keep high speed, the AI opponent will make mistakes and lose you. Don't be afraid of rolling ramps, pass the green arrows to speed up more easily. Keep calm and step on the gas!

title: Teacher Simulator Christmas Exam
description: Welcome to the funniest and busiest Christmas classroom ever! Teacher Simulator: Christmas Exam is a charming and playful teacher class simulator where you act as a holiday teacher. Manage orders, hand out exam papers, grade tests, etc. Different classes are scheduled on different days of the week, such as art class, geography class, math class, and so on.

title: Cosmos 404
description: Explore the galaxy in Cosmos 404! Run across procedurally generated tiny planets, collect coins, and dodge hostile aliens. Use power-ups like Speed Boost and Magnet to survive longer. How far can you go in this addictive low-poly space adventure?

title: Mermaidcore Aesthetics
description: In Mermaidcore Aesthetics, you'll embark on a thrilling undersea adventure alongside three fabulous fashionistas. Each mermaid has a unique and stunning wardrobe that will make your inner fashionista do a happy dance! With a wide selection of clothing options and accessories available at your disposal, you'll have endless possibilities to create your fashionable mermaid looks. Have a blast!

title: Obby: Pogo Parkour!
description: Obby: Pogo Parkour! is a dynamic arcade game where you control a character on a pogo stick, overcoming various levels filled with obstacles. Buy and upgrade your pogo sticks to complete challenges faster and more efficiently. Compete with players from all around the world and aim for the top of the leaderboard. Dive into the thrilling world of parkour on a pogo stick and test your reflexes in Obby: Pogo Parkour!

title: Perfect Job Run
description: Run your way to the perfect job. In the Perfect Job Run, you'll run the platform of the workplace. Facing various challenges, selecting the right career path and becoming a winner in the workplace. There will be different career tests along the way. Quickly select tools to accomplish tasks.

title: Overprotective Boyfriend
description: Imagine the beautiful Princess Marie standing in front of a mirror, looking at her reflection. Her eyes are shining, and a sly smile plays on her lips. She is ready to put on an outfit that will emphasize her grace and charm. But then her lover appears and frowns: «My dear, are you really going to wear such an open dress?» Marie knows that her faithful knight sometimes takes too much care of her, but today she intends to look dazzling!

title: Idle Trade Routes
description: Command a growing fleet of merchant ships across a shimmering ocean in Idle Trade Routes. Link bustling islands, auto‑dock at busy ports, and optimize trade lines to keep goods flowing. Unlock new ships, hire captains, and chase bigger contracts as your profits grow even while you’re away.

title: The Zombie House
description:
Protect your home from endless waves of zombies!
Defeat zombies to collect coins and ability drops.
Use coins to upgrade both your player and your house.
Each level makes the zombies stronger.
How long can you survive?

title: Mega Ramp Car
description:
Mega Ramp Car is a game with maximum speed and huge jumps! Are you ready to make the biggest leap in history?

Mega Ramp Car Features
- Realistic physics and sound effects.
- Real car collection
- This game allows you to perform amazing stunts on different jumps.
- Complete multiple levels and game modes for non-stop fun!
- You have to complete many challenging missions, which makes the game even more exciting.

Buy new cars to win new races.

title: Tung Sahur Bots Chase Room
description:
Horror brainrot bots are on the hunt! Watch out, stay alive!

Welcome to Tung Sahur Bots Chase Room – the ultimate brainrot meme horror escape game!

Get ready for heart-pounding chases as you find yourself trapped in backroom full of unpredictable Tung Tung Tung Tung Sahur, Tralalero Tralala Bots and other viral meme creatures. Can you keep up with the chaos, dodge the brainrot traps, and make it out alive? Only the fastest runners will escape this nightmare.

title: SuStainable
description: As the watchful guardian of a prestigious museum, you're tasked with protecting the priceless artwork from eco-activists turned vandals. To succeed, you must scour the exhibition halls, gather clues, and apprehend the culprit in the act. Once apprehended, you'll conduct a tense interrogation to uncover the truth. Will you be able to find the incriminating paint bucket before the damage is done, or will the suspect's cunning and your own inexperience lead to a disastrous outcome?

title: Airport Master Plane Tycoon
description: Airport Master - Plane Tycoon is an airport management simulation game. With 3D stickman models, you can control the manager of a larger airport. Each level has a target passenger for you to complete. You can unlock the gate, scanner, security check, and lounge in the tutorials.

title: Tag Run
description: Tag Run is an adrenaline-fueled multiplayer action parkour game where 1–4 local players race to ditch the bomb and be the last standing! Tag opponents, use teleport pads and jump springs, and survive thrilling matches with 6 players. Explore six dynamic maps: Pixel, Winter, Lava, Jungle, Candy, and Night, and packed with creative power-ups. Test your reflexes, strategy, and parkour skills in this fast-paced, chaotic playground challenge.

title: Match Master
description:
Match them all!
Match all same pairs in the given time to win the game and earn coins. Use various powerups to match them faster. Spen your coins to decorate your house and unlock new houses.

title: Siberian Assault
description: Siberian Assault is an intense first-person shooter set deep in the unforgiving Siberian wilderness, where players are dropped into a hostile winter jungle brimming with enemy forces. As an elite operative, your mission is to survive relentless waves of enemies in this icy, snow-laden environment.

title: Dirty Money The Rich Get Rich
description: Dirty Money: The Rich Get Rich is a money clicker relaxation game. You are permitted to make money by tapping. When you earn some money and level up on the corresponding level, you can speed up by upgrading in the Growth, using the Invest, and making the Assets. The more money you make, the more functions you can unlock and use. I hope you will complete the target and make 100 million!

title: Cricket Clash Pong
description:
Get ready to swing, hit, and defend in Cricket Clash Pong, an exhilarating blend of classic Pong gameplay and the beloved sport of cricket. This game promises endless hours of fun, challenging players to master the art of the digital pitch with a dynamic twist on traditional gameplay.

Exciting Features:
Multiple Game Modes: Whether you’re in the mood for a quick match or a full-blown tournament, Cricket Clash Pong has a mode to suit every player

title: Gear Wars
description: Do you have the strategic skill to build a flawless factory, producing Brutes, Archers, and Grunts? Manage your budget wisely, crush every enemy, and claim victory! Get those gears spinning... it's time to WIN!

title: Bubble Shooter Ultimate
description: Bubble shooter ultimate is a classic bubble shooter game with a modern twist. Each level-up you get to chose a power up like a change to get a bomb or rainbow bubble and more. Create combinations of three or more matching bubbles by launching bubbles of the same color at them. The more bubbles you pop in a single shot, the higher your score. If you miss a match 5 times, the playing field moves down by one row. The objective is to score as many points as possible while clearing all the bubbles!

title: Pin Board Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Pin Board Puzzle where really difficult puzzles await! ?

Immerse yourself in a maze of twisted iron sheets, bolts and nuts, and plates, pinned with discarded bolt pieces and rings, presenting an epic and complex puzzle match. Let's feel the excitement in the new unscrew and screw pin game and become a screw master.

As a seasoned technician, skillfully unblock screws and untangle each twisted iron piece from the jigsaw of obstacles.

title: Blocks Stack Rush
description: Enjoy an addictive stacking adventure. In Blocks Stack Rush, you’ll control a little block character running and begin a fun pixelated journey. Collect blocks, stack them high and race against time to build the perfect picture. You need to align each block and keep putting together the complete picture.

title: Word Connect Puzzle
description: Word Connect Puzzle is a relaxing yet brain-boosting word game. Swipe letters to form hidden words, unlock new packs, and watch the difficulty rise as your vocabulary grows. Earn stars, complete daily challenges, and use hints when you’re stuck. Play offline anytime, enjoy clean visuals and smooth controls, and chase streak bonuses for higher scores. Perfect for quick sessions or long puzzle runs—smart, simple, and satisfying for all ages.

title: Girl Coloring Dress Up Games
description:
Brand new girl games are already waiting for you! Start creating your own coloring pages by dressing up dolls and painting pictures for backgrounds. You’ll get hundreds of color options, textures and patterns, glitter and gradients. Create your coloring book from scratch, color dresses, and improve your clothes designer skills. If you like drawing that’s the free coloring apps you’ve been looking for!

?️Creative Coloring Games for Girls?

✪ Play as a doll designer: select hair, dress up, and pick accessories
✪ Design clothes: use gradients, textures, and patterns
✪ Combine stylish looks and haircuts like in famous girl games
✪ Color without numbers and paint with glitter
✪ Create coloring pages: move and change dolls and backgrounds
✪ Zoom in and out for better results
✪ Makeover dolls and backgrounds
✪ Paint wallpaper for your phone in fun color games 
✪ Take pictures right in the game and share them with friends easily
✪ Free coloring book offline with many options

title: Cinema Business - Idle Games
description:
Build and manage your own cinema empire! 
Unlock movie rooms, snack and burger corners to attract more customers.
Hire staff, upgrade facilities, and keep your theater running smoothly.
Earn cash even while you’re offline and grow your business.
Become the ultimate cinema tycoon in this fun idle arcade game!

title: Kingdom Wars TD
description: Welcome to Kingdom Wars TD, an exciting tower-defense strategy game set in a captivating 2D kingdom. Assume the role of a skilled commander entrusted with the defense of a mighty castle. In your quest, assemble a formidable army comprising up to five soldiers, including archers, warriors, and priests. Brace yourself for the challenge of surviving two perilous waves across various meticulously designed levels scattered throughout the map. Immerse yourself in this thrilling adventure!

title: Animal Bus Traffic Jam
description: All aboard for the cutest puzzle ride ever in Animal Bus Traffic Jam. This clever match-3 sort puzzle and casual logic game challenges you to help adorable animal passengers find their correct buses. Each level is a traffic jam of colorful buses filled with cats, dogs, pandas, and more. Your mission is to sort the animals by type or color, match them into the right buses, and clear the jam with smart moves.

title: RobyBox - Space Station Warehouse
description:
Your main task is to place boxes in their designated places to open doors and advance through the levels. Be on the alert! Aggressive bots will chase you. You can destroy them with a powerful arsenal including drill, disks, mines and rockets. Traps are scattered throughout the levels - use them to your advantage by luring the bots into dangerous areas. 
When you need a break from the intense gameplay, head to the warehouse where you can earn gold and solve Sokoban-style puzzles in peace.

title: Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle
description:
Find & Restore: Hidden Puzzle! is a relaxing and brain-teasing puzzle game where you must spot, drag, and fix the misplaced parts of beautiful images.
Each level challenges you to find hidden pieces, pull them out, and place them exactly where they belong.
With handcrafted levels, soothing music, and satisfying visuals, it's the perfect game to relax and train your observation skills.
Can you restore every picture to perfection?

title: Fruit Catcher
description:
Catch as many fruits as you can before they fall! ?
Move your basket left and right to collect fresh fruits and avoid rotten ones. Each fruit gives you points — how high can your score go?
This fun and colorful game tests your reflexes and speed. Perfect for kids and casual players who love simple but addictive gameplay!

title: 3D Basketball.io Dunk Sport
description: Sports Basketball is a thrilling 3D basketball game that will keep you entertained for hours. Whether you're a basketball fan or just love fast-paced Sports games Fun

title: Gem Deep Digger
description: Dive deep into the underground world of Gem Deep Digger. In a fun and addictive simulation game,you dig, collect, and upgrade to uncover hidden treasures. With simple one-button controls, anyone can become the ultimate miner. Use your dig to carve through layers of dirt and rock, uncovering sparkling gems in the ground.

title: Kick the Noobik 3D
description:
Smash, slice, blow up, incinerate, and unleash your creativity. Arm yourself with an endless arsenal: rockets, swords, machine guns, torture devices, and even a BIG BOOM. Welcome to Kick the Noobik 3D – more than just a game! Craving more kicks?

Even if you're usually calm, everyone needs to vent sometimes. Kick the Noobik 3D is the PERFECT WAY TO RELIEVE STRESS!

title: Magic Christmas Tree Match-3
description: Magic Christmas Tree Match-3 is a free New Year's match-3 game where you'll complete vibrant levels, create combinations of three or more, earn bonuses, and help the heroes decorate the festive town. Solve match-3 puzzles, combine elements, use power-ups, explosions, and super combos to complete tasks faster and advance the story.

title: Farm: Merge Harvest
description: Transform your land into a beautiful farming haven. Start with a small plot and grow it by merging crops, designing structures and unlocking new areas. The more you build, the more surprises await, bringing new rewards and adventures at every stage!

title: Mahjong Connect (Legacy)
description: Mahjong Connect is a mahjong game to match all the tiles to clear the board. Can you beat all the levels?
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Last to leave circle Obby
description:
Last to leave circle Obby - is a dynamic online game in the style of Roblox, where only the most dexterous and persistent can win! Exciting obby challenges, dangerous traps and intense battles with other players are waiting for you. Going outside the circle means you're out, and the circle is getting smaller and smaller!

Tense obby challenges that will test your reaction and agility.
Roblox-style game with unique multiplayer.
Ability to compete with friends and players from all over the world.

title: Jewelry Idle
description: What is the best jewelry? Of course, those made with your own hands! Create the best jewelry store! Design stunning pieces, attract discerning customers, and watch your business thrive in this sparkling venture!

title: Big Bad Ape
description: In Big Bad Ape, you will play as an unstoppable giant ape. Join this casual battle and experience the exhilaration of destroying a city! Freed from a lab experiment, this furious monster is now unleashed. As this super monster, your job is to destroy everything.

title: Spring Tile Master
description: Welcome to Spring Tile Master! Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of spring as you match tiles adorned with blooming flowers, colorful leaves, and charming insects. Draw tiles from the board to form sets of three. Keep up to 9 tiles in your stack and shuffle when needed. Collect all tiles to unlock new levels. Enjoy the enchanting springtime adventure and become the ultimate Spring Tile Master!

title: Toy Assembly 3D
description:
Assemble a wide variety of brick buildings and scenes in this classic constructor game. Start as a baby builder and level your way up to increasingly complex construction sets. This relaxing and
satisfying game is sure to bring you back to the imagination and fun of your childhood!  Find the right piece and simply tap to add it to your build.  Get hands-on fun without the clutter or accidentally stepping on toys.

title: 100 Hidden Capybaras
description: Are you ready for a hidden object game that's as cute as it is challenging? Jump into "100 Hidden Capybaras" – the ultimate hidden object adventure where your mission is to find and collect 100 adorable capybaras, each hiding in beautifully designed scenes! Explore stunning environments filled with lush forests, charming villages, secret dungeons, and unknown planets. Discover all hiding spots for our fluffy friends as you put your observation skills to the test.

title: Striped Fruit - Watermelon Land
description:
Welcome to the enchanting world of Striped Fruit that full of strategy and fun. Here, you'll become a watermelon maker extraordinaire, mastering the art of fruit merge to create the juiciest combinations on the board. As a merge master, you'll tap, drop, and combine fruits in a strategic dance.

The challenge? To reach your way to the top, the first step is to merge 2 melons to create a watermelon - the King of Fruits. Can you merge 2 watermelons to smash them out? Let's check it out!

title: Ball Tower of Hell
description: Ball in hell rolling his way to the top of the tower. There are many difficulties on the way, but the brave ball not scared

title: Home Match: Tile Master
description: Tile Master - Classic Triple Match & Puzzle Game is a challenging matching game.? In the game, you need to blow your mind and match 3 numbers of blocks. When all tiles are matched, you can pass the current level!? Our puzzle game includes large numbers of levels. Some levels might be hard. Challenge your mind and solve the puzzles, and then you will find them easy and exciting!

title: Stickman Brawler
description: Embark on an epic stickman conquest in Stickman Brawler, where you navigate a relentless battlefield, pitted against hordes of stickman adversaries. Harness your combat skills by selecting up to three powerful abilities, such as devastating swipe kicks, golem summoning, and colossal transformations. Unlock achievements, gather town resources to acquire potent power-ups from the godfather, and collect cards for exciting new skins, as you strive to become the ultimate stickman brawler.

title: Chicken Banana Quest
description: Help the Chicken and Banana to solve all puzzle quest and find the play button. Use your skills to solve the puzzles before the lives run out and complete all levels with the less possible clicks

title: Wacky Dungeon
description: Wacky Dungeon is a cartoonish action-packed RPG in which you can fight interactive battles against the weirdest of enemies.  Release Date January 2021  Developer Blue Infinity developed this game.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Magic and Wizards Mahjong
description: Enter the enchanting world of Magic & Wizards Mahjong! Match mystical tiles adorned with runes, potions, and magical artifacts across beautifully crafted layouts. Enjoy smooth gameplay with boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Undo, Torch, and Freeze. Race against the clock to earn time bonuses, or use extra seconds to finish your quest. With 50 rotating layouts and stunning wizardly visuals, every match feels like a spellbinding adventure for Mahjong lovers and casual players alike.

title: Zombie Road: Shooter with Destruction
description: Grandpa is eager for adventure again! Survive in a harsh zombie world. This time, Grandpa has to save the world from evil zombies. Zombies can drive and shoot! And Grandpa can destroy evil spirits! Fight the most dangerous mutants. Buy cool guns, find unique attachments, assemble your own unique gun and go into battle! Many locations, go through the whole world, from hot deserts to sea battles!

title: Tanky.io
description: Tanky.io is an intense arena shooter where you control a powerful tank in epic team battles. Destroy geometric shapes to gain experience, level up your tank, and unlock devastating upgrades.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: FNaF Shooter
description: FNaF Shooter is a first-person shooter game where you survive and save the world from the invasion of animatronics! Release Date February 2022 Developer GoGoMan made this game.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Jetpack Joyride
description: Jetpack Joyride is a fast-paced endless runner where you join Barry Steakfries in an action-packed adventure through a high-tech lab. Dodge lasers, ride wild vehicles, and equip jetpacks to outsmart scientists.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Gym Simulator - Tycoon
description: Welcome to Gym Simulator - Tycoon, where your business dreams take shape in the world of fitness. In this engaging online game, you'll manage and grow a network of gyms—upgrade your facilities, invest in top-notch equipment, and fine-tune every detail to run smoothly. Whether you're playing on your phone or computer, dive into a game where strategy meets a passion for health. With dynamic gameplay, you'll turn a small operation into a booming fitness brand.

title: Save Memerots: Acid Lava lake
description: Run forward, collect Brainrots, and try not to get caught by the rising lava. Upgrade your Brainrots to earn more, and improve your base to place even more characters.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Lulu's Fashion World
description: Lulu's Fashion World is a beauty game where you dress-up Lulu, collect fashion items, and be the top fashion designer. Do some experiments and create unique fashion trends!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Marble Puzzle Quest
description: Marble Puzzle Quest is a fun and addictive casual puzzle game where your task is to sort colorful marbles into the correct slots. With each new level, the challenge grows — chains become longer and more colorful, while the space for moves gets tighter. Use logic, plan ahead, and clear the board! Watch out: the marbles fill four slots at the top, and only three of the same color will disappear. Place them incorrectly, and you lose the round.

title: Stunt Bike Rider Bros
description: Stunt Bike Rider Bros is a motorcycle racing and show game that you can play in both 1 player and 2 player mode with your friend. There are 3 different game modes in the game. In the "Racing Mode", you can compete with both your friend and other motorcycle drivers. In the "Career Mode", try to complete the difficult stages in a limited time. In the "Open World", you can earn coins and diamonds by performing various stunts with your motorcycles.

title: Bubble Trouble 2: Rebubbled
description:
A classic arcade bubble shooter where you play as a devil in a trench coat, armed with a harpoon gun to tackle dangerous bouncing bubbles. Each bubble you shoot splits into smaller ones until they're completely destroyed. Navigate through levels with platforms and power-ups while avoiding contact with any bubble.

How to play:
- Clear all bubbles from each level to progress
- Avoid getting touched by bubbles - or lose a life
- Features single-player and cooperative multiplayer modes

title: Cosmic Tetriz Puzzles
description: Join a cosmic puzzle adventure where Tetriz meets pixel art. Place colorful Tetriz-style pieces on a grid to create shapes, ranging from easy to complex. Each piece has its own spot, adding to the challenge. Complete 45 levels, solving cosmic Tetriz puzzles in a space-themed setting. Can you beat this cosmic challenge before time's up?

title: Antarctica 88
description: Antarctica 88 is a horror game where you’re part of a rescue squad investigating a research station in Antarctica after communications went dark. It's up to you to solve the mystery.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Moto Stunts Driving & Racing
description: Moto Stunts Driving & Racing is a typical motorcycle-racing balanced game with 2D cartoon riders. On side-scrolling platform tracks, you need to arrive at the finish as fast as you can in both Racing Mode and Level Mode while keeping your rider alive. Try to earn coins and buy a new motorcycle first, the initial bike can only help you complete the game instead of making a new record for better rewards.

title: Panda Mahjong Classic
description: The panda has a challenge for you. You will face five tests on your way to the top. Attempt to finish all stages and earn the honor of being a Mahjong master.

title: Merge Haven
description: Merge items to restore the café to its former glory, uncover hidden secrets, and discover its mysterious past. Start merging today to reveal the café's enchanting story!

title: Grand Cyber City
description: Grand Cyber City is a driving game in a sci-fi world. The game contains various game modes such as missions, racing, free drive, derby, and challenge.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Money Man 3D
description: Try the thrilling Money Man 3D game, You play as a money character and run through tricky levels. Watch out for obstacles that can break your money body. Collect scattered money to build yourself again and use power ups for help. Finish a level, turn into a money ball, and aim for a briefcase with double money for big rewards. Ready to run, rebuild, and roll to financial victory

title: Lost in the Forest
description:
Lost in the forest is a classic adventure game. The protagonist is an airman who ends up in a storm, loses control of his plane and falls into a mysterious forest.
The next day is stuck under a tree and must find a way to break free and solve various puzzles to make it back home safely.

title: Rooftop Challenge
description: Rooftop Challenge is an exhilarating parkour adventure where players must leap, climb, and strategize their way through a sprawling urban landscape. Starting from ground level, the goal is to find the elusive "house" that serves as the gateway to even greater heights. Once found, the journey continues as players ascend rooftop after rooftop, navigating complex jumps, narrow ledges, and towering structures.

title: Count Masters Superhero
description: In Count Masters: Superhero, begin an interesting parkour adventure like no other! As a superhero,you're constantly running, jumping, and avoiding obstacles throughout the level. Such as avoiding rotating mace, cutting machine and so on.

title: Dog Escape
description: Welcome to Dog Escape, the hide-and-seek puzzle where saving a dog is only the beginning. Guide a lost canine through traps and guards, then bring it home to cuddle, feed, and style! If you adore puppy-care, dress-up, and dog games with heart, this is your new daily ritual. Rescue your puppies now!

title: Split Shot: Ball Adventure
description: Drag the ball, set your direction, and navigate through a cosmic field! Collect all the stars while skillfully avoiding dangerous spikes. How many can you gather?

title: Idle Gun 2
description: Idle Gun 2 is a clicker game where you develop an arsenal of weapons through clicking and idling. Start with regular pistols and work your way up to powerful sniper rifles.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Tower Crash 3D
description: Tower Crash 3D is an exciting casual game that challenges you to demolish towering structures! With physics-based 3D gameplay, only the most skilled crashers can conquer all the towers.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Construction Truck: Building Games for Kids
description: A vibrant and engaging construction game where kids can build houses, drive vehicles, and explore a world of fun activities. With easy-to-follow instructions, children learn new words, develop skills, and enjoy creative play in a safe, interactive environment.

title: Blob Opera
description: Blob Opera is an experimental music game developed by David Li in collaboration with Google Arts & Culture. The game uses a machine learning model trained on real voices to make it easy for anyone to create amazing operatic music!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Twisted Rope
description: Get ready for a mind-bending challenge! ? Twisted Rope Puzzle 3D is a captivating game that will put your problem-solving skills to the test. Dive into a colorful world of tangled ropes and work your way through increasingly complex puzzles.

title: Steam Sorter
description: Take control of a cute robot and get to work sorting industrial garbage! A dynamic puzzle game with a steampunk aesthetic.

title: Gun Racing
description: Here you cannot just race with other cars, but destroy them with the help of numerous weapons. Improve your riding skills and take first places in tournaments!

title: Neon Core Breaker
description: Neon Core Breaker is an idle, Arkanoid-style game where you destroy blocks in a vibrant neon world. Break through waves of blocks, earn rewards over time, and progress even while idle as you upgrade your power and push deeper into increasingly challenging levels.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Realm Traveler
description: Realm Traveler is set in a classical fantasy world. In the beginning, a conflict between light and darkness shaped the continent known as the Amis Continent.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Treasure Champion - Chest Capture
description: Dive into the exciting world of stickmen in this exciting team game! Your task is to capture the chest in the center of the field and deliver it to the base together with your team, avoiding traps and tricky moves of your opponents. Each successfully delivered chest brings points, and the dynamics of the game keep you in suspense until the last second.

title: Sniper Elite 3D
description: Prepare to enjoy the finest 3D sniper experience ever with the most thrilling and action-packed shooting game! Sniper 3D is the ultimate free gun game that immerses you in the life of a lethal assassin.
